description: You can construct function and list types from small records.

steps.description: fresh can generate distinct variable names. TVar represents a type variable, while TCon represents a named fixed type.
TFun holds a parameter type and return type. TList holds an element type, and the constants name Int, Bool, Str and Nil.

steps.answer: It displays (α -> α), using the same variable for parameter and return types.
steps.question: How will TFun(a, a) display when a is TVar('α')?

steps.description: You see (α -> α), (Int -> Bool) and [Int] in the printed examples. These records describe types without evaluating language expressions.

title: Building types as data
